title: sasamorpha borealis var. angustior
intro:
Sasamorpha borealis var. angustior, commonly known as  Angustior Sasamorpha, is a type of plant species within the genus Sasamorpha, which is a group of flowering plants native to the alpine and subalpine regions of Asia.

There is limited information about this specific plant species, but generally, plants in the Sasamorpha genus have been used in traditional medicine for their health benefits. The health benefits of Sasamorpha borealis var. angustior may include its potential anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. However, more research is needed to confirm its therapeutic actions, bioactive constituents, and overall effectiveness as a medicinal plant.
